notes.title: 50% off, update & cheat code
notes.notes:
Hey all, hope you are settling into 2018 well. We're on sale @ 50% off this weekend only, so please enjoy!

After much life adjustment, we are diving back into Everything and have some nice updates for our international players coming up, also a very interesting offshoot project, more on both later.

A cheat code (in case you missed it from twitter) - if you start a new game with the name 'Fool' - all objects, abilities and narration come unlocked. This is a little bit like NG+ but designed for testing the hell out the game and starting with a full library.

In the meantime - what would you like to see in Everything? Specifically, is there something in the logic, controls or timing that you found frustrating or could be improved? Let us know in the comments below. 

thanks and best wishes,

David

P.S. we're nominated at DICE & GDC Choice this year, nice nice nice

notes.title: 1.06 Patch Notes & Linux support!
notes.notes:
Hey!
It's been only 1 week since we launched - and what an incredible week it has been.

Everything has been the #2 trending game on Steam for the past week [according to SteamSpy] so thank you for helping spread the word - and for taking the time to write nice reviews. It helps!

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28196434/0e632e58d8c3c83be8bbe1453b562cd9cb83ae66.jpg

So - due to much support on the forum, and the help of some friends, we managed to release Everything for Linux! This includes all other features such as cloud saves and should run just as well as other platforms.

Other things in this build, now fixed:

    Proper support for multiple monitors/ultra wide screens
    Support for more controllers
    Disaster Switch fixed (find it in Settings)
    Some things were not being spawned, fixed. (thanks, completionists)
    A few very rare bugs squashed

Thank you again for your feedback, crash reports, and for playing. 

ːclassicbearː David ːbillygoatː

notes.title: 1.0502 patch notes
notes.notes:
Everything 1.0502 patch notes

    *new* Windowed mode (alt+Enter / Cmd+F)
    Now plays in non 16:9 resolutions
    Fixed some potential issues with attaining Join ability
    Disasters [the crazy auto-scene culling] appear less frequently
    Disasters can be switched off entirely in Settings
    Optimization of Galaxy scale which was causing crashes.
    Improved camera on growing things (less intense bobbing)
    Use of [~] to open Mind replaced with [m] key, as ~ isn't on some keyboards


Thank you for your crash reports & feedback. 

Also thank you for leaving nice reviews, we appreciate it! ːgreenfrogː
